acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

params.commands: A set of concatenated commands, each 1 byte in length
params.inputs: An array of byte strings containing abi encoded inputs for each command

lockAcquired(bytes).details: We force the onlyByVault modifier by exposing a virtual function after the onlyByVault check.

params.data: The data that was passed to the call to lock

returns._0: Any data that you want to be returned from the lock call

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pancakeV3SwapCallback(int256,int256,byte.details: In the implementation you must pay the pool tokens owed for the swap. The caller of this method must be checked to be a PancakeV3Pool deployed by the canonical PancakeV3Factory. amount0Delta and amount1Delta can both be 0 if no tokens were swapped.

params.amount0Delta: The amount of token0 that was sent (negative) or must be received (positive) by the pool by the end of the swap. If positive, the callback must send that amount of token0 to the pool.
params.amount1Delta: The amount of token1 that was sent (negative) or must be received (positive) by the pool by the end of the swap. If positive, the callback must send that amount of token1 to the pool.
params.data: Any data passed through by the caller via the IPancakeV3PoolActions#swap call

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner.

execute(bytes,bytes[]).notice: Executes encoded commands along with provided inputs.

lockAcquired(bytes).notice: Called by the pool manager on `msg.sender` when a lock is acquired

msgSender().notice: Public view function to be used instead of msg.sender, as the contract performs self-reentrancy and at times msg.sender == address(this). Instead msgSender() returns the initiator of the lock

pancakeV3SwapCallback(int256,int256,byte.notice: Called to `msg.sender` after executing a swap via IPancakeV3Pool#swap.
